description: This file defines Python bindings and utility functions for PyTorch modules, including conversion functions, dynamic class creation, and module binding helpers.

methods.name: py_object_to_device
methods.description: Converts a Python object to a torch::Device, checking for device type.

methods.name: py_object_to_dtype
methods.description: Converts a Python object to a Dtype, checking for dtype type.

methods.name: bind_cpp_module_wrapper
methods.description: Dynamically creates a Python subclass of torch.nn.cpp.ModuleWrapper that delegates calls to a C++ module.

methods.name: add_module_bindings
methods.description: Adds standard method bindings to a pybind11 class for an nn::Module subclass.

methods.name: bind_module
methods.description: Creates a pybind11 class for an nn::Module subclass with default bindings, optionally exposing forward method.
